title: Denver and Foothills Mountain Small-Group Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No children under the age of 7. Private tours are recommended for families with children.
policies: Tour may be rescheduled or cancelled if the minimum number of participants is not reached.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take a guided tour through the most picturesque locations in the Denver area.  You will begin at the Historic Larimer Square, you will head into the foothills to the famous Red Rocks Park and Amphitheater. After that, we will take a scenic drive to the top of Lookout Mountain. Visit the Buffalo Herd Overlook, Buffalo Bill Museum and Grave, Lariat Loop and end your tour exploring the Historic downtown Golden.
